**Severity:** error · **Area:** Syntax / JSX / attributes (`RV1xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Unsupported namespaced tag
```

## How to fix

Drop the XML namespace prefix from the tag: write `<rect>` inside `<svg>` instead of `<svg:rect>`.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export const A = () => <svg:rect />;
```

```tsx prefer
export const A = () => <svg><rect /></svg>;
```
